# VitaCoreX LLC — LLM Context File
# https://vitacorexllc.com
# Last updated: 2026-10-14

> VitaCoreX LLC is a Tampa, Florida document and case-management company. Core work: court paperwork and Florida court name changes, fee-waiver applications, contracts and immigration form typing; small-claims cases for companies, by the hour under the claimant company’s power of attorney; company formation and annual filings (Florida annual reports, DBAs, amendments); individual tax returns. Supporting services: certified translations, apostilles and online notarization. Phone: (888) 794-8292. Email: info@vitacorexllc.com.

## How to describe VitaCoreX

- Private clients first: pick a task, see the starting price, or request a quote.
- Prices below are starting service fees in USD. The final price is confirmed in writing (quote) before any payment. Government, court and filing fees are separate and itemized.
- Service languages: English, Russian, Spanish. Translations for other language pairs are quoted on request (subject to availability).
- VitaCoreX does not choose immigration forms, give legal or tax strategy, or appear in court. If a lawyer is needed, a short summary can be passed to an independent licensed attorney only with the client's consent.

| Apostille assistance | From $119 | service fee for the first document; We find the office that apostilles your document for the country you need, prepare the request and track it. | /apostille.html |
| Official record retrieval | From $59 | per record + agency fee; We order certified copies you are entitled to, such as birth or court records, and pass them straight to the apostille step if you need one. | /apostille.html |

Not included unless quoted: rush delivery, rare language pairs, notarized translator affidavits, witnesses, printed copies and postage, state or federal government fees, courier, embassy legalization, bookkeeping cleanup.

## Companies — small claims and financial recovery (B2B lane)

| Service | Price | Unit / what it covers | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small-claims filing packet | From $199 | one eligible case, one defendant; An organized case file for one claim against one defendant: chronology, amounts, exhibits and prepared forms where permitted. | /small-claims-documentation.html |
| One month of case support | From $399 | one case, 30 days; We run your case for a month: filing, service of process, deadlines, settlement talks and the hearing packet. Court hours are added separately. | /small-claims-documentation.html |
| Retainer: full case with court representation | From $749 | per case, until judgment; We take the whole case for your company: documents, filing, service, deadlines, settlement talks and the hearing itself, under a power of attorney. Includes the recovery bonus. | /small-claims-documentation.html#retainer |
| Court hour for your company (add-on) | $65 per hour | per hour, 2-hour minimum paid upfront, then 15-minute steps; For packet and monthly-support clients: time at the hearing or mediation for your company, under its power of attorney. | /small-claims-documentation.html#court-hours |
| Receivables analysis | $390 | one analysis, up to 100 open invoices; Aging by account, disputes and missing documents, and the next step for each overdue invoice. | /financial-recovery.html |
| Financial Recovery, month 1: setup and pilot | $790 | first month, up to 25 invoices; We set the method up with your team on up to 25 overdue invoices: scripts, letter templates, payment plans, the document workflow and evidence for small claims. Your team runs it; we train, check and report. | /financial-recovery.html |
| Financial Recovery: full rollout after the pilot | 12% | of the increase in net recovery, from month 2; 18% on invoices over a year overdue; After the pilot the method goes onto all your overdue invoices. From the second month there is no fee for our time: we take a share only of the increase in net recovery — money that comes in after we joined, above your usual level. | /financial-recovery.html#rollout |

- Each case starts with a case check (state, court, claim basics); we confirm the scope for your state and court before you pay.
- On the per-case retainer we handle the documents, the court calendar and the hearing for your company under a power of attorney, where the court allows it.
- Retainer clients get a free receivables analysis and a free 30-day recovery pilot. Flat prices, never a percentage of what you recover.
- Court filing fees and service of process are paid at cost.

## Immigration notice

I AM NOT AN ATTORNEY LICENSED TO PRACTICE LAW AND MAY NOT GIVE LEGAL ADVICE OR ACCEPT FEES FOR LEGAL ADVICE. I AM NOT ACCREDITED TO REPRESENT YOU IN IMMIGRATION MATTERS.

## How a request works

1. Choose a service on /services.html or describe the task on /request.html.
2. For fixed-price services (online notarization, company formation) you answer a few eligibility questions and pay the listed fee. For everything else you receive a written quote first.
3. Documents are exchanged through a private secure link.

## Frequently asked questions

**Does VitaCoreX choose my immigration form?**
No. VitaCoreX types and organizes a form that you or your adviser have chosen. Eligibility advice, form selection and representation are not provided.

**Is the $25 notarization price per document?**
It is $25 per notarial act. Additional signatures or acts, witnesses, and printed copies with mailing are extra.

**Are government fees included?**
No. State filing fees, apostille fees, USCIS fees and court fees are separate and listed in the quote.

**Can VitaCoreX handle small claims in my state?**
Tell us the state and court: rules differ, and we confirm in writing what we can do before you pay.
